- Evidence: `shopper_ext_alcohol_procedure_excusal.rule` "The hand-off praise credit counts the 5-star ratings the shopper received less than one whole month before the decision". - "Recorded" counts include expired violations (prior wrong-address 95f9dda7, prior alcohol a8695992, prior drops 9ad0f6aa and 39342324). They would change three figures if excluded. The rule text ("violations recorded on the account less than twelve whole months before") admits only the inclusive reading, since the charter separates recorded and cleared entries. One reading.
